layout: Exercise atlases: 3 columns x 2 rows in catalog order (0-based index). Muscle atlas: 3 x 3. CSS displays each tile without resampling/cropping the original source file.
processing: Generated PNG sources retained in the Codex image library. Complete atlases converted to WebP quality 82 for offline delivery; no semantic changes during conversion.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE production sprite atlas for a fitness exercise app. A precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid of SIX SQUARE scenes, total image aspect ratio 3:2. No borders or gutters; identical pale warm gray background in each square. Each cell contains a complete clear three-quarter side-view gym exercise scene, one anatomically correct adult woman in charcoal leggings, mint athletic top and white shoes, using realistic graphite equipment. Clean polished instructional 3D illustration, gentle studio shadows, clear readable limbs, all body and equipment entirely contained within its own square with 8% padding. No text, numbers, labels, logos, arrows, watermark or extra people. EXACT scene placement: TOP LEFT: barbell back squat, bar securely across upper back, athlete at controlled bottom squat. TOP CENTER: goblet squat, holding ONE dumbbell vertically at chest, hips lowered. TOP RIGHT: Bulgarian split squat, rear foot elevated on a low bench behind her, dumbbell in each hand, front knee bent. BOTTOM LEFT: 45-degree leg press machine, woman seated against inclined backrest, both feet on raised platform, bent knees at mid press; machine recognizable. BOTTOM CENTER: seated leg extension machine, thigh supported, knees extending against padded roller at shins. BOTTOM RIGHT: forward lunge with two dumbbells, rear knee just above floor. The grid is strictly regular and each square is self-contained; do not combine different exercises within one cell. Instructional accuracy and distinct equipment matter more than stylization.
